purpose: Teach: 符号/執拗/再三/先々/最長/怠慢/随所/つくろ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、契約に符号管理を導入された
lines.en: Your father — when he founded the company, he introduced signature protocols into every contract.
lines.style: Quiet, measured reverence. Pause after the opening address. Even cadence, as if recalling a specific moment from decades ago with clear sight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは執拗な妨害にも屈しなかった
lines.en: Yes. He wouldn't bend, no matter how relentless the opposition was.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Slight weight on 「屈しなかった」— a quiet firmness that honours the choice without dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、再三の交渉で勝利された
lines.en: And through negotiation after negotiation, he came out ahead.
lines.style: Soft nostalgia in the tone. The weariness of age watching the strength of the past. Slight lift at the end, like remembering a hard-won victory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは先々の市場を見据えてらした
lines.en: He did. He could always see three moves ahead in the market.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. A moment of genuine recognition — not flattery, but the clarity of someone inheriting both a company and a vision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、最長の関係を取引先と築かれた
lines.en: He built relationships with his partners that lasted for decades.
lines.style: Warmth beneath the surface of age. Pride, but understated. As if pointing out something that speaks for itself without needing to be said.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の怠慢を見逃さなかった
lines.en: He didn't — he never let carelessness slip past him, not with his people.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The voice of someone who learned that standards and care go hand in hand. Direct, without blame.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内の随所にお父さんの哲学が残ってる
lines.en: His philosophy is still everywhere in the company. In everything.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate delivery. Eyes that have seen how ideas live longer than the people who hold them. A touch of satisfaction, and something like peace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは古い習慣をつくろう新文化を作られた
lines.en: Yes. He didn't just replace old habits — he built something entirely new in their place.
lines.style: Soft closure. The weight of inheritance acknowledged without strain. Breath settles at the end, as if a long conversation has found its resting point.
